caption: The drawing features a central square of ornate fabric displayed in a rich burgundy color with an intricate, symmetrical floral and scrollwork pattern in a lighter purplish-pink hue. Surrounding this fabric sample are five architectural or decorative detail sketches rendered in fine black lines on a beige background. These line drawings depict classical decorative elements: at the top center is an ornamental pediment with a central medallion featuring a woman's face; to the upper left and upper right are corner details of architectural moldings—one with tassels and the other with a shield motif; at the lower left is a pedestal or column base adorned with acanthus leaves and a garland; at the lower right is a caryatid figure, a female bust supporting an architectural element above her head. The lower right corner includes a label stating, "FABRIC 1/2, DETAILS 1/4 FULL SIZE F. Ward." The overall composition arranges the fabric sample centrally with the architectural drawings evenly dispersed around it on the page.
title: Detail of Sofa
